text: Assumption: MakeErrorCode is reentrant and thread-safe — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: MakeErrorCode is reentrant and thread-safe — is this correct?
norm: makeerrorcode is reentrant and thread safe
rationale: The specification designates MakeErrorCode as constexpr and noexcept without maintaining state, which is why absence of side effects and thread safety are to be assumed.

original.text: Annahme: Reentranz und Thread-Sicherheit — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation weist MakeErrorCode als constexpr und noexcept ohne Zustandshaltung aus, weshalb Seiteneffektfreiheit und Thread-Sicherheit anzunehmen sind.
